verdict.rationale: Portkey documents running its open-source AI gateway locally with a single command (`npx @portkey-ai/gateway`), and it exposes a REST inference API. Both mean the product can run headlessly without a UI, but nothing documents CI pipeline usage or automation-specific workflows. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or a Docker-in-CI recipe), non-interactive config/auth guidance for automation, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
